config.label: Homecastr API key
config.description: Homecastr API key. Use 'hc_demo_public_readonly' for free demo access (rate-limited). Get a full key at homecastr.com.

config.label: Base URL for the Homecastr API
config.description: Base URL for the Homecastr API. Defaults to https://www.homecastr.com - only override for self-hosted or staging environments.

config.label: Worldcastr alias for the same API credential
config.description: Worldcastr alias for the same API credential. HOMECASTR_API_KEY takes precedence when both are set.

config.label: Worldcastr API base URL
config.description: Worldcastr API base URL. Set to https://worldcastr.com. HOMECASTR_API_URL takes precedence when both are set.
